messages:
Alex Chen: deploy-bot completed rollout v3.2.1 to prod-us-west-2 with multiplexing change enabled. marking 100%

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 5xx and timeouts on /v1/generate in prod-us-west-2. p95 from 1.2s -> 7.6s, p99 from 2.9s -> 21.4s. 5xx rate up to 8.1%. Paging oncall.

Maria Lopez: ack, oncall-sre here. pulling up dashboards and logs. Alex, that deploy just landed?

Alex Chen: yes, pushed ~T-2m. new mux handling will coalesce requests per connection. saw no regression in canary but rollout was fast.

Kai Patel: looking at worker metrics: KV cache miss ratio jumped and eviction_count skyrocketed. many inference workers showing 'lock wait' stalls. latency heatmap shows p99 dominated by requests around 4k tokens, but also some short ones.

Samir Gupta: tagging customer impact: hosted API customers routing to us-west-2 seeing timeouts; Dedicated in other regions unaffected. I'll prep a short customer blurb.

Maria Lopez: gateway logs: repeated `502 UpstreamTimeout` and `504 backend timeout`. running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/gateway -c gateway --since=5m | grep -E "502|504" | wc -l
curl -s "${PROM}/api/v1/query?query=rate(requests_total{region=\"us-west-2\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])" | jq '.'
```

Kai Patel: inference-worker logs show:
```
ERROR kv_cache: eviction_threshold_exceeded count=2134
WARN rpc: stalled waiting for kernel response
```
I think multiplexing raised parallel KV reads per request and exposed a kernel selection regression causing stalls.

Alex Chen: can we cut traffic back to previous release? deploy-bot, can you rollback v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0?

deploy-bot: rollback requested by Alex Chen. Initiating rollback to v3.2.0. Estimated completion ~45s.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-078 opened. Severity: Sev2. Impact: Elevated timeouts and 5xx for generation endpoints in prod-us-west-2. Owner: Maria Lopez.

Maria Lopez: done — paused v3.2.1 and shifted traffic to v3.2.0. switching autoscaler to conservative mode to avoid oscillation. watching p95/p99.

Kai Patel: post-rollback telemetry: KV eviction dropping, p95 trending down within 30s. p99 still catching up but moving toward baseline.

Samir Gupta: customer comms: sending: "We observed elevated timeouts in us-west-2 after a recent deployment. We rolled back the change and are monitoring. Follow-up with RCA to come." Posting to affected accounts now.

Jen Park: support here — two enterprise tickets opened, engineers contacting reps. tagging accounts and noting incident id INC-2026-078.

Maria Lopez: short status update @5m post-rollback: error rate 5xx down to 1.1%, p95 1.05s, p99 3.4s. still slightly above normal but acceptable for now.

Kai Patel: repro plan: run traffic replay with multiplexing enabled against instrumented dev cluster to reproduce KV eviction pattern. will capture strace and kernel timings for the slow path. commands I'm using:
```
# fetch metric
curl -s "${PROM}/api/v1/query?query=kv_eviction_total{region=\"us-west-2\"}" | jq '.'
# attach lightweight perf
kubectl -n prod exec -it inference-worker-0 -- perf record -a -g -- sleep 30
```

Alex Chen: immediate mitigations: we rolled back, set conservative autoscaler, added an emergency gate to block multiplexing configs until signoff. follow-ups: add canary gating on p99 and KV metrics, and a quick toggle at gateway to limit per-request multiplexing.

Samir Gupta: impact assessment: ~5% of total traffic experienced elevated errors for ~9 minutes. peak 5xx ~8.1%. Two customers reported failures. No confirmed SLA breaches yet; verifying logs and request traces.

Maria Lopez: handing off to next oncall: Jen Park will take over in 30 minutes. runbook appended: rollback complete, autoscaler conservative, monitor kv_eviction_total and p99 for 1 hour. RCA owner: Kai Patel.

Jen Park: taking handoff. I'll set a 30-minute checkpoint and will escalate if p99 > 5s or error_rate > 2%.

Kai Patel: creating PR to revert multiplexing logic and add `gateway.config.multiplex_limit` with sane default. also adding KV eviction and kernel latency to pre-deploy smoke checks.

incident-bot: INC-2026-078 status updated -> Mitigated. Severity lowered to Sev3.

Maria Lopez: we'll draft a postmortem and schedule a 45-minute RC meeting tomorrow to decide rollout policy changes. add any relevant logs/traces to the incident thread. :thumbsup:
